decision_conditions: Condition 2 (Accordance with Approved Plans) of planning permission reference 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024, is amended to:
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans:-
17115_05_00_07_051  Rev P3 (Proposed Sitewide Access and Routes)
17115_05_00_07_053 Rev P3 (Proposed Sitewide Parking Strategy Planning)
17115_05_00_07_104 Rev P4 (Proposed Roof Level Sitewide Plan)
SY619-400-0001 Rev P01 (Urban Ground floor landscape plan)
SY619-300-1301 Rev B (Urban Green Factor Site Wide)
17115_05_A_07_100 Rev. P2 (Block A Residential: Proposed Level 00 Plan)
17115_05_A_07_101 Rev. P1 (Block A Residential: Proposed Level 01 Plan)
Condition 2 (General compliance) of planning permission reference 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024, is amended to:
The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the following has been completed in accordance with the specified supporting plans and/or documents:
Northwood and Pinner Health Centre Energy Statemen Document ref:0212-INSIG-RP-MEP-08-REV P2, May 2023
Fire Safety Strategy Stage 4 Report, Revision P01 dated 10 July 2024
Flood Risk Assessment, Rev. B, 16 March 2021
Drainage Strategy, Rev. A (1st Issue) 15th May 2020

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, other than Conditions 2 and 3, which is superseded by the above condition, all other conditions relating to planning permission reference 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024, must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
The following plans have been superseded by the non-material amendments hereby approved and includes plans superseded by previous non-material amendment applications:
Fire Safety Strategy Stage 2 Report, Revision 04
The following plans have been approved by the non-material amendments hereby approved:
